Asset type: one standalone industrial design silhouette exploration, NOT a contact sheet.

Presentation: museum-quality sci-fi industrial design / hard-surface concept art, believable three-dimensional construction, exceptionally legible silhouette and architectural negative space. ONE centered object fully visible, floating slightly above a seamless neutral LIGHT GRAY studio floor/background with a soft natural shadow. Square image, object about 72 percent of image height, comfortable empty margins. Consistent near-orthographic three-quarter view, looking slightly down, long-lens perspective, no extreme foreshortening. Soft large directional key light from upper left, gentle fill, readable dark surfaces and cavity depth; no dramatic environment or theatrical effects.
Materials: restrained dense dark gray ceramic / graphite metal exterior, subtle roughness, small precise bevels revealing thickness; clean inner optical core, a slender polished non-spherical solid with only faint optical refraction and a subdued pale reflection. Form first, no texture-driven detail, no intense emitted light.

Ancient monument mass and impossible machining accuracy. Recognizable as a broken upright stele held apart by air, NOT three blades, stepped terraces, folded sheets or a hollow frame.
